media.title: MGM lion recording session — Hollywood context photograph, 1928
media.description: Background image for the Hollywood period card and collaboration section. Source now identified as the Bettmann / Getty Images photograph “Leo The Lion Being Recorded,” dated 28 January 1929 and reproduced on Photos.com.
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of a lion in a recording studio with sound equipment and film-studio personnel.
media.rightsNote: Public-domain route via Wikimedia Commons. The file page identifies the photograph as public domain in the United States because it was published without copyright notice and notes no evidence of original copyright registration. Use as MGM/Hollywood studio-context image, not as a Kaper-specific documentary photograph.
media.publicCaption: Photograph of the MGM lion roar being recorded in 1928, used as context for the studio system Kaper entered after arriving in Hollywood.
media.publicCreditLine: Wikimedia Commons, public domain in the United States.
